messages.subject: v1.2 branch and preview
parts:
Hi everyone, I just created a release branch for version 1.2, called v1.2. You can also read an introduction to the new release. Your feedback is welcome, but I need to warn you that only bug fixes and minor changes are possible at this stage. For v1.3 we hope to have a more open process where changes are discussed before they are implemented, when major changes are still possible. In  a way it's always been possible as almost any change and certainly important ones have associated issues in the github issue tracker, where you can add your comments, but I guess it's difficult to get the big picture from the tickets alone, and I've not been using milestones with the necessary zeal. More on v1.3 soon. And, by the way, welcome to our discussion group. I hope it will bring more of the conversations we've been having over email in the open. We are happy to reply to email, it's just that sharing our RHadoop problems and successes with the community multiplies the benefit of those conversations manyfold. Thanks

Antonio
